newsitem.title: USA: JPS Textile gets extension on credit facility.
newsitem.headline: JPS Textile gets extension on credit facility.

text.p: JPS Textile Group Inc said on Thursday that it had arranged for an extension of its revolving credit facility for two of its operating subsidiaries from May 1 through May 16.

"The extension ensures that the company and its operating subsidiaries will have the financial resources to continue business as usualy while JPS Textile, its holding company, continues discussions with its bondholders to revise its capital structure," the company said in a statement.

It added that should JPS Textile begin a case under chapter 11 of the U.S. bankruptcy code, the revolving credit facility will be extended automatically to November 1 or the effective date of a reorganization, whichever comes first.
JPS Textile is a domestic manufacturer of textile and textile related products. JPS has no publicly traded stock.
